# Fixtures for `bzip2` (bzip2)

Every file here was made for whiff's tests and is released under CC0-1.0. The content is a few
short texts about a fictitious harbour (Saltmere, Ben Gull, Ana Lighthouse), with fixed times
and the owner `saltmere:harbour`. Regenerate with `scripts/fixtures/archives.sh`.

| File | Origin | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `harbour-bzip2.tar.bz2` | `bzip2 -9` of a pax tar of the payload | CC0-1.0 |
| `notes-bzip2.txt.bz2` | `bzip2 -9` | CC0-1.0 |
| `saltmere-tides-1.2.0-py_0.tar.bz2` | `scripts/fixtures/packages.sh` (craft_packages.py): a conda package in the older `.tar.bz2` form, detected as conda inside the bzip2 stream | CC0-1.0 |
